content.text:
Clanker already has most transport foundations; the missing core is reliable product discovery and visual ranking.

| Component | Current code evidence | What remains |
|---|---|---|
| Reference image intake | Slack adapter downloads and caches images, using private Slack file URLs and authenticated, restricted CDN downloads. [adapter.py](/Users/tanishqpalandurkar/Projects/yyot/hermes/plugins/platforms/slack/adapter.py:4936), [download guard](/Users/tanishqpalandurkar/Projects/yyot/hermes/plugins/platforms/slack/adapter.py:6338) | Validate this exact UX with real uploads, thread replies, mobile photos and multiple garments. |
| Vision understanding | Gateway routes images either directly to the vision-capable main model or through auxiliary vision. [run_inbound.py](/Users/tanishqpalandurkar/Projects/yyot/hermes/gateway/run_inbound.py:1456), [native attachment](/Users/tanishqpalandurkar/Projects/yyot/hermes/gateway/run_turn_runner.py:1704) | Extract garment-specific attributes and crop the intended garment. Current text fallback is only a generic 2–4 sentence image description. [generic description](/Users/tanishqpalandurkar/Projects/yyot/hermes/gateway/run_inbound.py:1962) |
| Finding product candidates | Current Clanker toolset includes Kernel browsing, page-image extraction and screenshot vision. [tool list](/Users/tanishqpalandurkar/Projects/yyot/runtime/seatbelt/plugin.py:14), [image extraction](/Users/tanishqpalandurkar/Projects/yyot/hermes/tools/browser_tool.py:1192) | No shopping catalog, product-search adapter, image-search provider, visual embedding index, or recommendation/ranking service found in `runtime`. Browser-driven candidate discovery can prototype the idea but has latency and reliability limits. |
| Rich Slack recommendations | Slack supports the transport primitives in the repo: plugin action registration, interactive Block Kit posting and ordinary image delivery. [action registration](/Users/tanishqpalandurkar/Projects/yyot/hermes/hermes_cli/plugins.py:824), [interactive posting](/Users/tanishqpalandurkar/Projects/yyot/hermes/plugins/platforms/slack/adapter.py:4993) | No product-card renderer or recommendation-session state exists. Normal `send()` renders markdown to structural blocks rather than accepting structured product cards. [renderer selection](/Users/tanishqpalandurkar/Projects/yyot/hermes/plugins/platforms/slack/adapter.py:3170) |
| User interactions | Plugin callbacks can handle actions; app manifest includes `files:read`, `files:write`, `chat:write`, enabled interactivity and Socket Mode. [manifest](/Users/tanishqpalandurkar/Projects/yyot/config/slack-app-manifest.json:51) | Store request/result IDs and scope actions to requester/thread; implement “more like this,” budget changes, selection and pagination, plus stale-result handling. |

A significant misleading legacy detail: `clanker_web_search` and `clanker_web_fetch` implementations still exist, and baseline config says public web enabled, but the current Seatbelt plugin explicitly disables both and returns no discovery tools. [disabled names](/Users/tanishqpalandurkar/Projects/yyot/runtime/seatbelt/plugin.py:20), [empty discovery](/Users/tanishqpalandurkar/Projects/yyot/runtime/seatbelt/plugin.py:50). Do not describe Clanker as already having an enabled product-search API.

For the prototype, the minimum new backend result object should carry product ID, canonical merchant URL, image, title, observed price/currency, availability or “unknown,” similarity explanation, and check time. Product images and matching quality need separate checks: retrieving a page’s images does not identify which image belongs to which purchasable variant.

For presentation, the repo establishes custom Block Kit feasibility, but does **not** establish Slack’s current native carousel support; use the official docs research to decide that. The fallback is a few vertically stacked image cards or one card with Previous/Next controls updated in place.

Checkout should be a later phase: current docs explicitly identify end-to-end Indian card payments as a POC limitation. [ACCESS_MANAGEMENT.md](/Users/tanishqpalandurkar/Projects/yyot/docs/ACCESS_MANAGEMENT.md:67).

Read-only inspection complete; no live upload, UI, activation or end-to-end shopping verification was performed.
